item.stem:
The diagram shows Trisha's variegated leaf before the iodine test. Region G is green and region W is non-green. Leaf A stayed in sunlight. Leaf B was all green and stayed in the dark. Green colour is removed before iodine is added.

Answer both parts.

parts.text: Where should the blue-black starch result appear?

options.text: Only in region G of Leaf A.
In the green tissue of Leaf B as well as in region G of Leaf A.
In both region G and region W of Leaf A.
Only in region W of Leaf A.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.
